question: K-pop idols are exempt from military service
explanation: False: South Korea's exemptions cover cases such as Olympic medalists and top classical or ballet prize winners, not pop idols, who are drafted like other men.

question: The standard military service duration is about 18 months
explanation: True: active duty in the Army or Marine Corps lasts 18 months, while Navy and Air Force service run a little longer, at 20 and 21 months.

question: BTS received a special exemption and never served in the military
explanation: False: BTS received no exemption. All seven members carried out their mandatory service, and the last of them finished it in June 2025.

question: A law was passed allowing K-pop artists to delay enlistment until age 30
explanation: True: in December 2020 the National Assembly revised the Military Service Act so that pop stars honored with state medals can defer service until age 30.

question: Female K-pop idols also have to complete military service
explanation: False: conscription in South Korea applies only to men. Women, female idols included, have no duty to serve, though they may volunteer for the military.

question: Jin was the first BTS member to enlist for military service
explanation: True: Jin began active duty in the army in December 2022, the first of the seven BTS members to enlist; the others followed in 2023.

question: What was BTS's first full-length Korean studio album?
explanation: Dark & Wild, released by Big Hit on August 20, 2014, is BTS's debut studio album. Their 2013 debut 2 Cool 4 Skool was a single album.

question: Which album includes the song 'Spring Day'?
explanation: Spring Day came out in February 2017 as the lead single of You Never Walk Alone, the repackage of Wings, so it was not on the original 2016 Wings.

question: What was BTS's first song entirely in English?
explanation: Released on August 21, 2020, Dynamite was the first single BTS recorded fully in English. David Stewart and Jessica Agombar wrote it.

question: Which album was BTS's first to reach #1 on the Billboard 200?
explanation: Love Yourself: Tear debuted at No. 1 on the Billboard 200 in May 2018, BTS's first album to top that chart. Love Yourself: Her had peaked at No. 7 in 2017.

question: What is the name of BTS's 2022 anthology album?
explanation: Proof, released on June 10, 2022 through BigHit Music, is the first anthology album by BTS.

question: Which ENHYPEN member is a former figure skater?
explanation: Sunghoon skated competitively from 2010 to early 2020, representing South Korea in ISU Junior Grand Prix events, before debuting with ENHYPEN.

question: Who is the leader of ENHYPEN?
explanation: Jungwon is ENHYPEN's leader. He placed first in the final lineup of I-LAND, the 2020 survival show that formed the group.

question: Which ENHYPEN member is Korean-American and grew up in the US?
explanation: Jay, whose real name is Park Jong-sung, is ENHYPEN's Korean American member. He comes from Seattle in the US and moved to Korea as a child.

question: ENHYPEN's fandom name is what?
explanation: ENHYPEN's fans go by ENGENE, which is the name of the group's official fan base.

question: How many members are in IVE?
explanation: IVE has six members: Yujin, Gaeul, Rei, Wonyoung, Liz and Leeseo, and the lineup has not changed since the group's debut.

question: Which company does IVE belong to?
explanation: IVE is a girl group formed and managed by Starship Entertainment; Columbia Records only joined in 2023 as a partner for US promotion.

question: What year did IVE debut?
explanation: IVE debuted on December 1, 2021, the day their first single album came out.

question: What was IVE's debut single?
explanation: IVE debuted with the single album ELEVEN and its title track. LOVE DIVE (April 2022), After LIKE (August 2022) and I AM (April 2023) all came later.

question: Which IVE member was previously in IZ*ONE?
explanation: Wonyoung and Yujin both joined IZ*ONE through Produce 48 in 2018 and promoted with it until the group disbanded in April 2021.

question: What is IVE's fandom name?
explanation: IVE's fans are called DIVE, which is the name of the group's official fandom community.

question: Which unit does Hoshi lead?
explanation: Hoshi is the leader of SEVENTEEN's performance unit, which he shares with Jun, The8 and Dino.

question: Who leads the vocal unit?
explanation: Woozi leads SEVENTEEN's vocal unit, which also includes Jeonghan, Joshua, DK and Seungkwan.

question: Who leads the hip-hop unit?
explanation: S.Coups, who is also the leader of the whole group, leads the hip-hop unit made up of himself, Wonwoo, Mingyu and Vernon.

question: Which company acquired Pledis Entertainment?
explanation: Big Hit Entertainment became the largest shareholder of Pledis Entertainment in May 2020, and Big Hit changed its name to HYBE in March 2021.

question: Which SEVENTEEN member has composed the majority of their discography?
explanation: Woozi is SEVENTEEN's in-house producer: he writes and produces the group's songs, with the other members contributing.

question: What year did SEVENTEEN debut?
explanation: SEVENTEEN made their debut at a showcase on May 26, 2015, and their first EP, 17 Carat, came out three days later.

question: BLACKPINK has the most subscribers of any music group on YouTube
explanation: No music act has more YouTube subscribers than BLACKPINK, which became the first to cross 100 million, ahead of BTS's BANGTANTV channel.

question: K-pop idols commonly use Weverse to communicate with fans
explanation: Weverse, the platform created by HYBE, is built for artist-to-fan communication, and acts such as BTS, SEVENTEEN, ENHYPEN and BLACKPINK have joined it.

question: K-pop fans are known for organized streaming parties to boost chart numbers
explanation: True. Billboard reported in 2023 that fans now coordinate online to push releases up the charts by buying and streaming, and that K-pop fans appear especially good at organizing around chart goals.

question: BLACKPINK was the first K-pop group to headline which major music festival?
explanation: BLACKPINK were Coachella headliners, the first Asian act ever to top the festival's bill.

question: Which BLACKPINK music video was first to reach 2 billion views on YouTube?
explanation: The DDU-DU DDU-DU video passed 2 billion YouTube views on January 4, 2023, a first for a K-pop group. Kill This Love only reached that mark in September 2024.

question: BLACKPINK holds the record for most-subscribed music group on which platform?
explanation: BLACKPINK's YouTube channel is the most-subscribed of any music act and was the first to pass 100 million subscribers.

question: In which year did BLACKPINK headline Coachella?
explanation: BLACKPINK headlined Coachella on April 15 and 22, 2023. They had already played the festival in 2019, but not as headliners.

question: Which BLACKPINK member has the most Instagram followers?
explanation: As of October 6, 2026, Wikipedia's list of the 50 most-followed Instagram accounts gave Lisa about 105 million followers and Jennie 89.4 million; Rosé and Jisoo were not on it.

question: How many members did Super Junior originally debut with?
explanation: Super Junior started as a 12-member lineup with a rotating-member plan, which was dropped after Kyuhyun joined as the thirteenth member.

question: Which Super Junior song is one of the most iconic K-pop songs of all time?
explanation: Sorry, Sorry (2009) placed No. 12 on Rolling Stone's 2023 ranking of the best songs in Korean pop history and No. 15 on Spin's 2012 list of the greatest K-pop songs.

question: Which company does Super Junior belong to?
explanation: Super Junior was put together by SM Entertainment founder Lee Soo-man, and the group still releases music under SM and its dedicated label, Label SJ.

question: What year did Super Junior debut?
explanation: Super Junior made their official debut on November 6, 2005, performing the single Twins (Knock Out) on SBS's Inkigayo.

question: Which Super Junior sub-unit had the hit 'Oppa Oppa'?
explanation: Donghae and Eunhyuk launched their duo on December 16, 2011 with the digital single Oppa, Oppa, and later promoted as Super Junior-D&E.

question: Produce 101 Season 1 formed which group?
explanation: The first season of Produce 101 aired on Mnet from January to April 2016 and ended by naming 11 trainees as the girl group I.O.I.

question: Produce 101 Season 2 formed which group?
explanation: Produce 101 Season 2 aired on Mnet from April to June 2017, and its finale announced the 11 members of the boy group Wanna One.

question: Produce 48 formed which group?
explanation: Produce 48, Mnet's 2018 joint show with the Japanese group AKB48, ended with its top 12 contestants forming the girl group IZ*ONE.

question: Produce X 101 formed which group?
explanation: Produce X 101 aired on Mnet from May to July 2019, and its final lineup became the 11-member boy group X1.
